messages:
Sam Carter: @here QuillBank reporting increased 5xx rate from their dedicated pool starting ~03:10 UTC. Customer is within a 4-hour SLA window. Need a short-term workaround + clear owners by EOD. Any clues yet? @Priya @Jamal

oncall-bot: ALERT: quillbank-dedicated-pool high_5xx_rate detected at 2024-11-02T03:12:04Z. Alert ID: alb-7782. Pager sent to #eng-oncall.

Priya Nair: looking. can someone paste the recent deploy hash or autoscaler changes? i want to check rollout window.

Jamal Ortiz: saw a rollback-trigger from autoscaler rules last night. suspect new scaling rule + prefix-caching mismatch. quick check: `kubectl get events --namespace quillbank-prod | tail -n 50` showed repeated `pod evicted` messages.

Lina Gomez: FYI infra PR #4521 (autoscale backoff tweak) is still pending perf tests — that's the dependency. link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/4521

Sam Carter: ok — sounds like two options: 1) immediate workaround (pin customer to legacy pool / disable autoscale action) or 2) rollback the autoscale rule. which is faster and who owns?

Priya Nair: I can run the pin. plan: 1) route quillbank to `pool-legacy-eu` 2) disable new autoscaler trigger for that customer 3) watch 5xx/latency for 30m. ETA 20-30m. Will post commands+confirmation here before and after.

Jamal Ortiz: i'll open a hotpatch PR to revert the autoscale rule (tiny change) — PR #4589. If Priya needs SRE help to bump capacity or enable temporary quota, @oncall please ack.

Priya Nair: running command now: ```
# pin customer to legacy pool
redwood route set --customer quillbank --pool pool-legacy-eu --reason "emergency pin: 5xx spike"
```

Priya Nair: monitoring: checking p95/p99 and 5xx/min. please watch dashboards: https://dashboards.redwood/quillbank/dedicated/requests

oncall-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: incident quillbank-20241102 created. severity: p1 (customer SLA at risk). Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/quillbank-sla. Assigned: eng-oncall.

Lina Gomez: confirmed #4521 still blocked on perf; merging will take ~2h after tests. re-route is the safest short-term. after Priya confirms, i'll queue the perf run earlier to unblock merge.

Sam Carter: Ownership check: Priya -> execute pin & monitor (ETA 30m), Jamal -> hotpatch PR + follow-up (PR #4589), Lina -> unblock perf & verify merge window, Sam -> coordinate PM/customer comms. Milestones: 1) Pin applied & metrics stable (by 03:45 UTC), 2) Hotpatch merged & deployed (by 05:00 UTC), 3) Perf tests completed & autoscale rule re-enabled (by 06:30 UTC). Everyone ack?

Jamal Ortiz: ack. i'll watch for CI and ping when PR passes.

Priya Nair: pin applied at 03:18 UTC. 5xx/min dropping from 42 -> 6 in last 7m. p99 down from 840ms -> 300ms. continuing to monitor. will update at +30m. :thumbsup:

Sam Carter: great work. i'll loop in CSM + PM for customer note and confirm rollback plan once hotpatch lands. keep updates in this thread.

Lina Gomez: starting expedited perf run now. will post results and ETA for merge in 15m.

Priya Nair: +1 on updates here. if anything regresses i'll escalate to SRE for a temporary capacity bump.

Sam Carter: thanks team. tagging the incident checklist: owners mapped and short-term workaround in place. pls react with :white_check_mark: when you consider your item closed.
